quizGuardRationale: Declarations are direct, symmetric and nontransitive. Actual labels and complete ordinary secondary senses were inspected; shared topic or matching English substrings alone is not an equivalence claim. Batch 24 changes no existing word metadata or exclusion lists.

激増 guards increasing/rising labels, without treating the different direction-neutral 急激 adjective as the same action. 下車 guards getting off/descending and broad going-out wording; it does not mean every building departure.

下旬/月末 directly protect English late-month/end-month overlap without erasing the 21st-to-last-day definition. 月末/末 separately protects the established すえ end-of-month sense; no transitive inference is made for 下旬/末.

下水 is not equated with every water/liquid word simply by material class. 削る guards cutting, quantitative reduction, omission and textual erasure. The blade killing/slashing use of 斬る and 卸す's wholesale/grating/fish-cutting identity are not automatically the same action.
桁 guards numeral, number and numerical-place answers, including 位1155400 sense5 at くらい. A whole identifying number, a vertical pillar and an arbitrary row/column are distinguished rather than merged.

下駄 guards broad sandal/footwear labels, not every article of clothing or the action of putting footwear on. 血圧 protects broad pressure; 気圧 is specifically air pressure. 血液/血 already have identical blood titles and deduplicate without a new exclusion.
月給 guards salary/pay and broad income wording while teaching the monthly-salary restriction. 支給 as provision/payment of an allowance is distinguished from a salary basis, not automatically merged.

傑作 guards work and amusing/absurd evaluations. The selected humorous sense is positively taught and qualified; ordinary error/failure labels are not treated as equivalent to every hilarious absurdity.

気配 guards signs, indications, perceived feeling/presence/atmosphere and market tone/trend/conditions wording. 様子's indication, 雰囲気's presence/aura and 気's atmosphere senses count despite different primary labels. The separate 気味きあじ market sense does not justify its existing きみ guard; that guard rests on the latter's actual feeling/sensation sense. Worry remains unsupported, so no 心配 guard is inferred from the raw mismatch.

下品 guards actual vulgarity/indecency and English coarseness/crudeness ambiguity while distinguishing physical roughness or low quality in prose. 煙い is an adjective, not the smoke noun or the manner of billowing; no automatic topic-based guards are added.

蹴る guards rejection and additional foot-pressing overlap. 険しい guards steepness, severity and demanding/difficult wording, including 難しい's serious/glum-expression sense rather than only its first difficulty gloss.

見学 guards observation, inspection, outings/tours, seeing and study/learning answers while positively teaching the observational purpose. This does not assert that all research or instructed learning is a field trip. Sitting-out is separately additional.

謙虚 guards overlapping modesty/holding-back and humbled/obliged answer areas, not every humble action verb or poor-quality object. 原稿 guards manuscript/draft/prepared-copy/notes and broad written-text/document labels; copying as an act and all notebooks are not taught as manuscripts.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles cover twenty source rows; no reused article's old teaching is extended. The community source is not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Four primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs are added across 圧, 血 and 液. Existing 増 is N3 and receives the required substantive link in 激増.
Missing primary cards 激, 旬, 削, 桁, 駄, 傑, 蹴, 謙, 虚 and 稿 are not created. Every written primary Han character stays in metadata; alias-only missing cards are not fabricated.

Additional deletion for 削る, refusal/foot-pressure for 蹴る and PE sitting-out for 見学 do not independently gain N2. Complete unselected historical or specialist senses remain evidence, not automatic teaching requirements.
Public receipts describe actual lexical bodies and headings; raw HTML, authentication artifacts and incidental page forms are not preserved.
New original examples are pedagogical constructions, not corpus attestations or native-speaker certification. The one short borrowed 傑作 example is attributed to the actual dictionary.

All prior baseline identities, primary readings, titles, written-kanji arrays, tags and easier levels are preserved, along with prior exclusion additions recorded in batches 19 and 23. This batch adds no new baseline exceptions.
Initial reviewer evidence removes only quizGuardRationale. Mapping/source notes remain visible author assertions to assess; reviewers must not read the canonical packet or other-family reports.
